original_ai_output.title_zh: 武装青年在琼莱州拦截援助车队
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据世界粮食计划署（WFP）称，南苏丹琼莱州武装青年持枪袭击并威胁两名人道主义工作人员，迫使一支河道援助车队卸下食品援助。事件发生于9月29日阿约德县Chuilbong，当时车队正前往政府控制的Mogok和Ayod South。WFP表示，在无法确保安全通行的情况下，车队被迫卸下162.54吨食品。剩余车队及291.48吨食品已于10月2日安全返回马拉卡勒。

key_facts.fact: 武装青年在南苏丹琼莱州持枪袭击并威胁两名人道主义工作人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Armed youth in South Sudan’s Jonglei state assaulted and threatened two humanitarian workers at gunpoint

key_facts.fact: 事件发生于9月29日阿约德县Chuilbong
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident occurred on Sept. 29 in Chuilbong, Ayod County
WFP ordered the convoy team to offload 162.54 metric tons of food commodities under duress

key_facts.fact: 剩余车队及291.48吨食品于10月2日安全返回马拉卡勒
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the remaining convoy, including staff and assets belonging to WFP and its cooperating partner Action Against Hunger, as well as 291.48 metric tons of food destined for Ayod South, returned safely to Malakal on Oct. 2

uncertainties: 事件细节目前仅来自世界粮食计划署单一来源，尚未获得独立证实
